text:
Alex: FYI — Everspring (prospect) is asking for a 2-week eval focused solely on enterprise identity. Main asks: SAML SSO (Okta/Azure AD), SCIM provisioning with group sync + delta/PATCH support, RBAC mapping from IdP groups, domain ownership controls (DNS TXT + email), and audit log access. Also want pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated for ~100k requests/mo. Can we run this POC in 2 weeks?

Priya: + We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin). We can supply SAML metadata and an example SSO config.

Priya: For SCIM — we support: GET /Users, POST /Users, PATCH /Users (RFC 7644 patch semantics), group membership endpoints, and bulk delta via incremental sync. We also support SCIM over mTLS if they want mutual TLS.

Priya: RBAC — mapping is config-driven: SAML attribute -> role. We can map SAML groups to Redwood roles, and also ingest SCIM Group objects to drive role assignments. Custom attribute mapping is supported.

Priya: Quick sample SAML attribute mapping snippet for their IdP config:
```
<NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
<Attribute Name="groups">urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.5.1</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="email">urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3</Attribute>
```

Marco: Security notes — assertions are signed and we validate signatures + timestamps. SCIM endpoints require TLS1.2+, we can do mTLS for extra assurance. Data at rest is AES-256, keys are KMS-backed. We can provide audit log streams (syslog or S3) for 90 days by default; extended retention is an add-on.

Marco: For the security questionnaire: we can answer controls around encryption, key management, SAML signing, SCIM transport encryption, access logs, and incident response. We will need to attach our SOC2 Type II report and DPA.

Sameer: Legal can provide DPA + SOC2 Type II within the next business day. For Dedicated/Private deployments we have a standard addendum for data residency and key-holding. If Everspring needs customer-managed HSM, that’s available on Private only.

Lina: Proposed POC plan (2 weeks):
1) Day 0–2: Exchange SAML metadata + create dev tenant. Everspring provides test IdP (Okta dev org) or we provide test Okta.
2) Day 3–7: Validate SSO flows (SP & IdP initiated), test attribute mapping.
3) Day 8–10: Enable SCIM, test provisioning -> deprovisioning + group sync.
4) Day 11–14: Run RBAC scenarios, export audit logs, finalize sign-off.

Lina: I'll prep a mapping sheet for roles -> SAML groups and a SCIM schema mapping template. Can share by EOD Friday.

Alex: Pricing questions from Everspring: they expect ballpark numbers to validate budgeting. Lina / Priya — what should I give them?

Priya: Ballpark (for sizing only): Hosted eval for this traffic is typically in the $2.5k–$5k/mo range depending on token usage and embedding calls. Dedicated reserved capacity starts around ~$12k/mo for a small pool (includes capacity and a modest SLA) + onboarding. Private (on-prem/VPC) is enterprise pricing — typically quoted. Add-ons: extended audit retention, HSM, and advanced observability billed separately.

Alex: Noted — I'll give ranges and mark them as preliminary.

Marco: Potential blocker to flag: Everspring’s security team asked if we support SCIM attribute-level encryption and whether SCIM sync logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. We can forward logs to their S3/syslog or push events to Splunk/Datadog; attribute-level encryption is not a standard SCIM feature but we can evaluate a custom flow (mTLS + field redaction at rest).

Alex: @Marco can you draft the questionnaire answers for the SCIM/SAML sections? They want it back in 48h.

Marco: Yep — I’ll start a draft today.

deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding doc template uploaded — https://redwood.internal/templates/sso-scim-onboard.md :paperclip:

Lina: One more ops note — domain verification: we support DNS TXT for domain prove + email-based verification for individual domains. For multi-tenant customers with many domains we can bulk-verify via delegation (we require proof of control; we do not accept screenshots).

Alex: Great — next steps: 1) send POC plan + role mapping template to Everspring, 2) Marco drafts questionnaire answers, 3) Sameer prepares DPA & SOC2, 4) Priya prepares sample metadata & SCIM endpoint examples. Aim to kick off Monday.

Priya: I'll also include sample cURL for SCIM PATCH and a small Okta guide.

Alex: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I’ll update the customer and confirm Monday morning slot.
